validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — CONFIRMED. The 12-inch Torbat Heydariyeh–Kashmar gas line is a real, physically-existing transmission line. GEM's ONLY citation on the wiki page is the Iran Ertebat page for the Dizbad–Torbat Heydariyeh 30-inch line (that is P6009's source, not this line) — a citation weakness — but the same Dizbad project description independently states the 30-inch line 'eventually connects, near Abbas Abad, to the 12-inch Torbat Heydariyeh–Kashmar line,' establishing this line's existence. shahraranews.ir (Razavi Khorasan 33rd provincial-council session, 17 Oct 2025) independently names the Torbat Heydariyeh–Kashmar transmission corridor and reports a 16-inch reinforcement line 'in progress/under way' (خط ۱۶ اینچ نیز در دست اقدام است) to serve the southern counties. CLASSIFICATION — CORRECT. Both sources call it a gas transmission line (خط انتقال گاز) feeding southern Razavi Khorasan counties (Torbat, Mahvelat, Bardaskan, Kashmar, Khalilabad); not gathering/process/plant-internal, not oil/NGL. DUPLICATE — NONE. Not the same physical pipe as P6009 (Dizbad–Torbat Heydariyeh, 30-inch, 65 km); this 12-inch line connects to it downstream. The 16-inch ~77 km reinforcement is a distinct line (missing from GEM → Discovery candidate), not a duplicate of this 12-inch row. No overlap with any IGAT trunk or other roster entry. ATTRIBUTION — FLAG. GEM lists Owner1 = 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC). mizanonline (Dizbad–Torbat commissioning, 2023) confirms the operator/commissioning body is the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC / شرکت ملی گاز ایران, CEO Majid Chegeni) — consistent with this being a NIGC domestic provincial gas transmission line, not an NIOC line. Recommend correcting NIOC→NIGC. SPEC — Diameter 12 in is consistent with the Iran Ertebat/Dizbad description ('12-inch Torbat Heydariyeh–Kashmar line') and mizanonline (a 12-inch line supplied Torbat Heydariyeh before the 30-inch); medium confidence for the Kashmar segment specifically. Length is BLANK in GEM and left UNRESOLVED — the sourced 77 km figure belongs to the 16-inch reinforcement, not the 12-inch line, so I did not force it. Capacity BLANK, no independent figure — left blank. Status 'operating' is defensible: the 12-inch line has been in service (it predates and connects to the 2023 Dizbad line). GEM start/end were 'Asia→Asia' (placeholder); real endpoints Torbat Heydariyeh → Kashmar (see routes).

routes.corridor_desc: Runs west-southwest from Torbat-e Heydarieh (~35.27N, 59.22E) to Kashmar (~35.24N, 58.47E), a straight-line distance of roughly 68 km across southern Razavi Khorasan; the parallel 16-inch reinforcement on the same corridor is quoted at 77 km, so the routed length is ~70–77 km. The line serves the southern-county cluster (Torbat Heydariyeh, Mahvelat, Bardaskan, Kashmar, Khalilabad). Endpoints are firmly named; the exact intermediate routing (via the Abbas Abad tie-in) is not mapped — corridor is a defensible loose bound between the two named cities.
